  • 构造器详细资料

    • Potion

      public Potion(PotionType type)
      Construct a new potion of the given type. Unless the type is PotionType.WATER, it will be level one, without extended duration. Don't use this constructor to create a no-effect potion other than water bottle. 构造一个给定类型的新药水。除非类型为 PotionType.WATER，否则药水将为一级且不带延长持续时间。请勿使用此构造器创建水瓶以外的无效果药水。
      参数:
      type - The potion type 药水类型。
      另请参阅:
      • Potion(int)

      The potion. 该药水。

    • setHasExtendedDuration

      public void setHasExtendedDuration(boolean isExtended)
      Set whether this potion has extended duration. This will cause the potion to have roughly 8/3 more duration than a regular potion. 设置此药水是否具有延长持续时间。这将使药水的持续时间约为普通药水的 8/3 倍。
      参数:
      isExtended - Whether the potion should have extended duration 该药水是否应具有延长持续时间。

    • setSplash

      public void setSplash(boolean isSplash)
      Sets whether this potion is a splash potion. Splash potions can be thrown for a radius effect. 设置此药水是否为喷溅药水。喷溅药水可以被投掷以产生范围效果。
      参数:
      isSplash - Whether this is a splash potion 此药水是否为喷溅药水。
